description: This is a false-colour satellite image depicting a complex, rugged coastline with multiple marine inlets or fjords penetrating inland. Water bodies are represented in black. The land area is predominantly red, indicating dense vegetation, with some lighter blue/white patches suggesting bare ground or different land cover types. Three distinct yellow lines are overlaid, each marking a straight-line delineation across the mouth of a water body where it meets the sea. Each yellow line is associated with the numerical label "8330", which corresponds to the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) code for "Marine inlets and fjords" in habitat classification systems. The image illustrates the typical highly indented nature of such coastal features and their defined measurement points.
